messages:
Priya Patel: T-minus 10 — final stillness check before we enter the freeze. Quick yes/no on the items below please:
• pins applied to all release routes
• staging smoke tests green
• rollback lanes/runbooks reachable
• release notes uploaded
Reply with short flags; call out any last-minute risk.

Sam K: Applying pins now — will post deploy-bot confirmation.

deploy-bot: Received pin request: `/pin release/v3.2.1 --routes=v3 --reason='launch freeze'`
deploy-bot: Pin applied to route `v3` -> pinned to release/v3.2.1 (3 hosts).

Diego (oncall): Smoke suite in staging: all green except a flaky embed test (non-blocking). Saw a 15s tail latency spike earlier in staging jobs, mitigated by restarting worker-3. Production health baseline unchanged. :thumbsup:

Lina R: Rollback runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/rollbacks/v3.2.1-checklist
Lina R: Quick rollback checklist added at top of page (steps 1-5 + emergency contact numbers). I also uploaded the runbook artifact to the release notes.

Sam K: Release notes published: https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/tag/v3.2.1 — highlights: cheaper batching, small prompt fix, embed auth bugfix.

Priya Patel: Ok — we need explicit confirmations: pin, smoke, rollback access, release notes. One-line confirmations only pls.

Lina R: ✅ rollback runbook reachable and tested.

Sam K: ✅ pins applied and verified by deploy-bot.

Diego (oncall): ✅ smoke tests green in staging; monitoring hooks in place for prod.

deploy-bot: Canary kickoff: starting canary for release/v3.2.1 on route `v3` at 10% traffic. Monitor dashboards: https://dash.redwood/ops/v3-canary

Priya Patel: If canary holds for 5m with no error-rate > 0.5% and latency within 1.5x baseline, we'll start gradual ramp. Otherwise we roll back immediately.

Diego (oncall): Watching CPU, p95 latency, and error-rate. I set an alert on p95 > 1.5x and error-rate > 0.5%.

release-manager-bot: Quiet window entered by @Priya Patel. Freeze active until 1739916000. Owners: Priya Patel, Lina R, Diego (oncall). No non-emergency merges.

Priya Patel: Thanks team — staying in channel for the next 15. Call out if you see anything odd, otherwise we proceed on green.

Sam K: :white_check_mark: ready

Lina R: :white_check_mark: ready

Diego (oncall): Monitoring — will post if thresholds tripped.

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% stable for 3m. No increased error-rate observed.

Priya Patel: Good — continuing to 50% if stable at 5m.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 50% traffic. Rolling metrics window open.

Diego (oncall): Noted. No alerts yet.

Priya Patel: Final: proceed with gradual ramp after 5m stable at 50%. If any rollback decision is needed, tag Lina + Diego and run `/rollback release/v3.2.1` — we have the runbook.
